blurb: Grant Hawkridge is a self-described market chartist and enthusiast who posts technical analysis threads on US equities indices ($SPY, $SPX, $NYA, $COMPX). His work focuses on inter-market cycle analysis — tracking the sequential roll-overs of bonds, stocks, and commodities — and he references voices like @allstarcharts as part of his analytical framework. His profile bio ('Golf, cigars, whisky & looking at charts') signals an engaged hobbyist/independent analyst rather than a credentialed professional.
